svg.text: UTC start: 2026-09-09T01:29:31.749000+00:00 | campaign: COMPLETED | single run
TPS = all analyzed sampler requests / 60s; redirect children excluded. Latency includes failures. Minute 1 includes the ramp.
Anchor = minimum JTL request-start time; bins are [0,60), ... [840,900). Missing observations are gaps, not zeros.
Lag = sampled mean and sampled maximum (~15s observations), not continuous maximum; bins use collector timestamps.
CPU = overlap-weighted counter rates at each DB's acquisition time; gaps >35s / resets excluded. No quota normalization.
CPU coverage: Primary 893.8/900s; Replica 894.1/900s. Hollow CPU points: <57/60s coverage.
Hollow request points: incomplete end boundary; hollow lag points: <3 observations. Single diagnostic; no causal A/B claim.
